import "array"
import "date"
latest = from(bucket: "senior_project") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "object_detection") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.channel == "DI0") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "detected") |> group() |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), _value: if date.sub(d: 15s, from: now()) > r._time then 2.0 else float(v: r._value)}))
union(tables: [array.from(rows: [{_time: time(v: 0), _value: 2.0}]), latest]) |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"]) |> last()
